correctness.rationale: Every proof hypothesis and boundary \(2\le m\le n\) is explicit. The identity \(w=mn-|Z|+|D|\) and matching bound yield the minimum/equality structure, constructive triangular coloring proves attainability, a \(k\)-subfamily of failed two-color constraints has union cardinality \(k(m+n-k-1)\) and its overlapping monochromatic constraints admit exactly \(2^{mn-m-u+1}\) extensions. Inclusion-exclusion proves the formula. Exact independent exhaustive tests on nine boards and full four-label minimization on three boards agree; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact number of optimal labeled two-rainbow defenses on the canonical rook-graph family is a natural robustness/multiplicity invariant not implied by its scalar optimum. The general formula resolves correlated row-and-column deficiency events, gives all optimizer placements and colored completions, and yields an asymptotic fraction for every fixed number of rows. It is an all-parameter structural enumeration, not an arbitrary small numerical instance.
